messages.text: Benchmark results are in: Snowpipe Streaming p95 is 6 seconds; the Kafka connector in file mode was 45 to 70 seconds. Also, nobody on the team wants to operate a Kafka Connect cluster.
+1. Offset tokens give us exactly-once per channel, and there are no staging files to clean up.
Convincing. Write it up as an ADR and I will approve it.
<@U20202BBB> I am getting schema violations from payments.v1 events with major version 2. Should they go to a dead letter table?
Yes. I opened ATL-7 for dead letter handling. Until then the consumer skips and logs them.
Thanks. My daily balances mart (ATL-4) needs those events, so I will wait for ATL-7.
Retention proposal for raw events: keep 400 days in Snowflake, then archive to S3.
Compliance needs 7 years for ledger entries, and the archive must stay queryable for auditors.
Understood. I will use external tables over the archive. Updating ATL-9.
